verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MailerSend has registrable webhooks with retries and a reachability test request on creation, but nothing about signed payloads, signing secrets, or signature verification code. A reachability test and retry behavior are adjacent webhook features and do not establish authenticity verification, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify webhook authenticity — signed payloads with documented signature verification code — so spoofed events can't poison my delivery state
